tests.name: Login with valid administrator credentials
tests.expected: Dashboard opens; role shown as Administrator

tests.name: Login with wrong password
tests.expected: Rejected with generic message; no session; failed attempt audited
tests.actual: "Invalid email or password."; session=null; audit="Login failed"

tests.name: Three failed logins lock the form
tests.expected: Lock message appears after the third failure; the valid password is also refused while locked
tests.actual: "Too many failed attempts. Locked for 30 seconds." then valid password: "Too many failed attempts. Try again in 30 s."

tests.name: Verification Officer tries to open the Audit Trail
tests.expected: Audit menu hidden; direct attempt denied and logged
tests.actual: menu hidden=true; message shown; audit="Access denied"

tests.name: Upload a text file renamed to .png
tests.expected: Rejected: content is not a real image
tests.actual: The file content is not a real JPG, PNG or PDF (the extension does not match its content).

tests.name: Upload a file larger than 10 MB
tests.expected: Rejected with size message; OCR not started
tests.actual: File too large (10.5 MB). The limit is 10 MB.

tests.name: File name containing an HTML/script payload
tests.expected: Payload shown as plain text; no script executes

tests.name: Genuine certificate end to end (JPG)
tests.expected: OCR reads 5/5 fields; all Matched; classification Genuine; request saved and audited
tests.actual: Genuine, risk 0/100, 5/5 fields Matched; audit="Completed verification"

tests.name: Certificate with altered student name
tests.expected: Name field Mismatched; classification not Genuine; evidence box on name
tests.actual: Suspicious, risk 30/100, 1 field(s) Mismatched, 1 red evidence box(es)

tests.name: Certificate whose number is not in the institution records
tests.expected: All fields Not Found; classification Suspicious (cannot be confirmed)

tests.name: Genuine certificate supplied as PDF
tests.expected: PDF page rendered, OCR succeeds, classification Genuine, ELA marked not applicable
tests.actual: Genuine, risk 0/100; ELA not-applicable notice shown=true

tests.name: Impossible issue date entered during review (2026-02-31)
tests.expected: Verification blocked; field-level error shown; stays on review screen
tests.actual: "Use a real date in YYYY-MM-DD format."

tests.name: Correct an OCR field, then verify
tests.expected: Edited field flagged as edited and used in cross-validation

tests.name: Administrator override with and without justification
tests.expected: Empty justification refused; valid one saved to audit with original and revised class
tests.actual: empty -> "Enter a justification of at least 10 characters."; saved: Administrator override / Forged / "Original: Suspicious; reason: Issue date contradic..."

tests.name: Reload the page and check stored data
tests.expected: History, records and audit trail still present after reload

tests.name: Audit-chain tamper detection
tests.expected: Editing a stored audit entry is detected by 'Verify chain integrity'
tests.actual: before edit: "✓ Audit chain intact: 7 entries verified." | after edit: "✗ Audit chain BROKEN at entry 2 of 7: the stored history has..."

tests.name: Add an institution record with a duplicate certificate number
tests.expected: Rejected with duplicate message; record count unchanged
tests.actual: "A record with this certificate number already exists."; records 5->5
